gpu_decision: L1 microstructure is per-event incremental rolling state (O(1)/O(window) updates at microsecond cost); it is latency-sensitive and applied only to actionable symbols. Dispatching these tiny per-event updates to the GPU would add dispatch latency far exceeding the compute, so CPU is the validated path. GPU remains reserved for batched numerical workloads (covariance, Monte-Carlo) where it is justified; a future batched cross-sectional microstructure pass over the full universe could revisit this.
device_note: Latency-sensitive protective execution is kept independent of any GPU workload (addendum / §25).
